You could say this is basically a brothel with the maid cafe skin. 

This is a scenario where you play as one of the maids and the AI will generate the rest as you go. It's more fun if you create a character and go RPing as them, also edit the bot's message or be explicit in your messages for better output. At the end of the day, you gotta teach the AI what you want.
